CreateCertificate.description_en: Uploads the certificate and private key for a domain name that has been added to WAF
CreateCertificate.description_zh: 为已添加的域名配置记录上传证书及私钥信息

CreateCertificateByCertificateId.description_en: Creates a certificate for a specified domain name based on a certificate ID by calling the CreateCertificateByCertificateId operation
CreateCertificateByCertificateId.description_zh: 调用CreateCertificateByCertificateId接口根据证书ID为指定域名创建证书

CreateDomain.description_en: Add a domain name to a WAF instance for protection
CreateDomain.description_zh: 将域名接入WAF实例进行防护

CreateProtectionModuleRule.description_en: Creates a configuration rule in a specified WAF protection module, such as Web Intrusion Prevention, Data Security, Advanced Protection, Bot Management, Access Control, or Rate Limiting
CreateProtectionModuleRule.description_zh: 在指定的WAF防护功能模块创建配置规则，如Web入侵防护、数据安全、高级防护、Bot、访问控制、限流

DeleteDomain.description_en: Deletes the configuration information of a specified domain name
DeleteDomain.description_zh: 删除指定域名配置信息

DeleteInstance.description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance or an expired subscription instance
DeleteInstance.description_zh: 释放Web应用防火墙（WAF）按量付费实例或者到期的包年包月实例

DeleteProtectionModuleRule.description_en: Deletes a rule configured in a specified protection module by calling DeleteProtectionModuleRule
DeleteProtectionModuleRule.description_zh: 调用DeleteProtectionModuleRule删除指定防护模块中配置的规则

DescribeCertMatchStatus.description_en: Checks whether the certificate and private key uploaded for a specified domain name configuration match
DescribeCertMatchStatus.description_zh: 检查指定域名配置上传的证书和私钥信息是否匹配

DescribeCertificates.description_en: Queries the available existing certificates for a specified domain name, that is, certificates that are already managed in SSL Certificates Service
DescribeCertificates.description_zh: 获取指定域名可选的已有证书，即已在SSL证书中进行管理的证书

DescribeDomain.description_en: Queries the configuration information of a domain name that has been added to WAF protection
DescribeDomain.description_zh: 查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的配置信息

DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs.description_en: Queries the detailed configurations of domain names that have been added to WAF for protection
DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs.description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainAdvanceConfigs查询已添加到WAF防护的域名的详细配置

DescribeDomainBasicConfigs.description_en: Queries the basic configurations of website domain names that are added to Web Application Firewall (WAF) for protection
DescribeDomainBasicConfigs.description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainBasicConfigs查询已接入WAF防护的网站域名的基本配置

DescribeDomainList.description_en: Invokes DescribeDomainList to perform a paged query of domain names that are added to WAF for protection
DescribeDomainList.description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainList分页查询已添加到WAF防护的域名列表

DescribeDomainNames.description_en: Retrieves the list of domain names that have been added to a specified WAF instance
DescribeDomainNames.description_zh: 获取指定WAF实例中已添加的域名名称列表

DescribeDomainRuleGroup.description_en: Queries the ID of the protection rule group bound to a domain and the status of the intelligent rule hosting feature by calling DescribeDomainRuleGroup
DescribeDomainRuleGroup.description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRuleGroup查询域名绑定的防护规则组的ID及智能规则托管功能的启用状态

DescribeInstanceInfo.description_en: Queries the details of a WAF instance under the current Alibaba Cloud account
DescribeInstanceInfo.description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下WAF实例的详情

DescribeInstanceSpecInfo.description_en: Queries the specification information of a WAF instance

DescribeLogServiceStatus.description_en: Queries the log collection status (whether log collection is enabled) of domain names that are added to WAF for protection
DescribeLogServiceStatus.description_zh: 查询已接入WAF进行防护的域名的日志采集状态（是否开启日志采集）

DescribeProtectionModuleCodeConfig.description_en: Queries the region codes that can be configured in the WAF region-level IP blacklist
DescribeProtectionModuleCodeConfig.description_zh: 调用DescribeProtectionModuleCodeConfig查询WAF地域级IP黑名单中支持配置的地域代码

DescribeProtectionModuleMode.description_en: Retrieves the current protection pattern of a specified domain name, such as the RegEx protection engine, big data deep learning engine, HTTP flood protection, data risk control, and proactive defense
DescribeProtectionModuleMode.description_zh: 获取指定域名配置当前的防护模式，如正则防护引擎、大数据深度学习引擎、CC安全防护、数据风控、主动防御

DescribeProtectionModuleRules.description_en: Queries the rule configuration records of WAF protection features, such as Web Intrusion Prevention, Data Security, Bot Management, Access Control or Rate Limiting, and Website Whitelist
DescribeProtectionModuleRules.description_zh: 查询WAF防护功能规则配置记录，如Web入侵防护、数据安全、Bot管理、访问控制或限流、网站白名单

DescribeProtectionModuleStatus.description_en: Queries the status of WAF protection features, including Web Intrusion Prevention, Data Security, Advanced Protection, Bot Management, Access Control, and Rate Limiting modules
DescribeProtectionModuleStatus.description_zh: 查询WAF各防护功能的状态，包括Web入侵防护、数据安全、高级防护、Bot管理、访问控制或限流等模块

DescribeWafSourceIpSegment.description_en: Queries the back-to-origin IP addresses and CIDR blocks used by WAF protection clusters
DescribeWafSourceIpSegment.description_zh: 查询WAF防护集群使用的回源IP网段

ModifyDomain.description_en: Modifies the configuration of a domain name that has been added to WAF
ModifyDomain.description_zh: 修改已创建的域名配置

ModifyDomainIpv6Status.description_en: Enables or disables the IPv6 security protection feature for a specified domain name configuration
ModifyDomainIpv6Status.description_zh: 开启或关闭指定域名配置的IPv6安全防护功能

ModifyLogRetrievalStatus.description_en: Enables or disables the log search feature for a specified domain name
ModifyLogRetrievalStatus.description_zh: 为指定域名开启或关闭日志检索功能

ModifyLogServiceStatus.description_en: Enables or disables the log collection feature for a specified domain name configuration by calling the ModifyLogServiceStatus operation
ModifyLogServiceStatus.description_zh: 调用ModifyLogServiceStatus接口开启或关闭指定域名配置的日志采集功能

ModifyProtectionModuleMode.description_en: Modifies the WAF protection mode for modules such as the RegEx protection engine, big data deep learning engine, CC attack protection, data risk control, and proactive defense
ModifyProtectionModuleMode.description_zh: 修改WAF防护模式，如正则防护引擎、大数据深度学习引擎、CC安全防护、数据风控、主动防御等模块

ModifyProtectionModuleRule.description_en: Modifies the configuration rules of WAF protection features, such as web intrusion prevention, data security, advanced protection, bot management, access control, throttling, and whitelists
ModifyProtectionModuleRule.description_zh: 修改WAF防护功能的配置规则，如Web入侵防护、数据安全、高级防护、Bot、访问控制、限流、白名单

ModifyProtectionModuleStatus.description_en: Enables or disables a specified WAF protection feature, such as web intrusion prevention, data security, advanced protection, bot management, access control, or throttling
ModifyProtectionModuleStatus.description_zh: 打开或关闭指定的WAF防护功能，如Web入侵防护、数据安全、高级防护、Bot管理、访问控制或限流

ModifyProtectionRuleCacheStatus.description_en: Updates the cache of a page protected by a specified web tamper-proofing rule
ModifyProtectionRuleCacheStatus.description_zh: 更新指定网站防篡改规则所防护的页面的缓存

ModifyProtectionRuleStatus.description_en: Enables or disables WAF protection feature modules for a domain name, such as web tamper-proofing, legitimate crawlers, crawler threat intelligence, custom protection policies, and website whitelists
ModifyProtectionRuleStatus.description_zh: 启用或禁用域名WAF防护功能模块，如网站防篡改、合法爬虫、爬虫威胁情报、自定义防护策略、网站白名单

MoveResourceGroup.description_en: Moves a WAF resource to a different resource group
MoveResourceGroup.description_zh: 将一个WAF资源转移到其他资源组

SetDomainRuleGroup.description_en: Configures the protection rule group used by the regular expression protection engine for a specified domain name. In addition to the three system default protection rule groups, you can also select a custom rule group
SetDomainRuleGroup.description_zh: 为指定域名配置选择正则防护引擎使用的防护规则组，除系统默认的三种防护规则组外，也可以选择自定义规则组
